name: TUI
sells: Its own package holidays: flight, hotel and transfer booked as one product.
limitation: Only its own inventory. It cannot show you a competitor's price for the same hotel.

name: schauinsland-reisen
sells: Its own package holidays, including early-booking (Fruehbucher) prices for the following summer.
limitation: Only its own inventory, and its range is narrower than the large operators.

name: alltours
sells: Its own package holidays, with a strong Spain and Balearics programme.
limitation: Only its own inventory. Hotel choice is limited to what it contracts.

name: Check24 Reisen
sells: A comparison of package holidays from many tour operators in one search.
limitation: It compares what its partner operators feed it, so a small operator may be missing entirely.

name: Urlaubspiraten
sells: Editorially picked travel deals, each linking out to the operator or booking site that sells it.
limitation: A deal feed, not a search. You cannot ask it for a specific destination and date.

name: Booking.com
sells: Accommodation only: hotels, apartments and guesthouses, booked per room.
limitation: No flight and no transfer. A package holiday has to be assembled from separate bookings.

name: Kiwi.com
sells: Flights only, including combinations of airlines that do not normally sell together.
limitation: No hotel and no transfer. Self-transfer itineraries carry their own risk if a leg is delayed.
